sections.title: Conquest Dynasties
sections.description: This course will introduce students to current scholarship on and analytical approaches to the pre-Mongol Inner Asian conquest dynasties that ruled significant portions of China the Liao, Jin, and Xixia regimes. Core readings will consist of secondary scholarship in English, with an additional section covering primary source documents for students with reading ability in Classical Chinese.
